flags.message: Research degraded but prediction completed: CourtListener MCP precedent search returned HTTP 429 (daily quota), and fedcourts corpus-info cannot report freshness with the service backend. The forecast uses the provisioned August 29 snapshot, petition and committed prior-Term statpack; no claim of current corpus-wide vintage or independent live precedent verification is made. A service-compatible corpus vintage report would let cells satisfy the freshness contract.
